high_level_description: The image depicts a scene from what appears to be a video game or a digital narrative. The central focus is a piece of parchment with a message written on it. The parchment has a slightly aged appearance, with some edges appearing burnt or charred, suggesting it might have been exposed to fire or extreme heat. The text on the parchment reads: "Our Lord has made it clear; he will wait no longer. Three shards have already been destroyed. No more shall be taken from him.
